workstream: long_loci part 7: S-add (strand-first pieces added to the unmodified tree) on both frozen bases; DPANN development, Spacedust check rows
status_when_written: Part 6 complete and read (REPORT6.txt): S / SB gain 54-81 accurate runs and cost DefenseFinder / CRISPR-Cas F1 (family base) or summed excess -.017 (list base). No part-7 variant built or scored; the mechanism check below not yet run. The lut set and the SR-VP set stay closed.

mechanism_check.when: before any part-7 variant is scored
mechanism_check.data: part-6 S outputs at the frozen theta (family base L4b .2, list base L4b+ .02) against the frozen base, per curated instance (package gold, DefenseFinder / TXSScan / CRISPRCasTyper, >= 2 members, scorer rule), all genomes and even genomes
mechanism_check.worse: instance F1 under S lower than under the base
mechanism_check.spans_strand_change: the instance's member genes lie on both strands (primary); also reported: a strand change anywhere between its first and last member
mechanism_check.report: share spanning a strand change among worse instances, among unchanged and among better instances, and among all instances; by caller
mechanism_check.expectation: share among worse >= .6 against <= .35 among all instances

variants.S-add: nodes of the unmodified tree of the base (kept as the base keeps them) UNION the single-strand nodes (no strand change inside) of the strand-first tree (part-6 S weights) that are not already nodes of the unmodified tree; added nodes pass the base's own node rule (family base: closed-form family node test at the bond tau; list base: every node with >= 2 genes). Reported: nodes added, and added nodes that cross a kept base node without nesting
variants.S-add+B: the same construction with part-6 bridges applied to both trees: nodes of the B tree UNION the single-strand nodes of the SB tree not already in the B tree
variants.unchanged: bonds, cohesion, bridges (part-6 sets), node rules, scorer

bases: list base Z (primary interest) and family base P, as in part 6
selection: theta in {.02, .05, .1, .2} on DPANN odd genomes by the part-1 rule [odd conditions vs DH, odd resolved, odd summed]; applied mechanically before the even report
justified: all of, against the frozen base: accurate ribosomal runs (audit strict) >= base + 50; all seven DPANN bars; 0 new pairs of distinct curated systems in one locus; summed DF + TXSS excess >= base - .01 and F1 of DefenseFinder, TXSScan and CRISPRCasTyper each >= base - .01 (even genomes, points)
reported: part-6 tables (even curated scores, seven bars, paired vs frozen base, standing recovered / resolved with paired difference, any fitting locus, audit strict / loose, boundary precision, curated-pair check, verdict-1 repairs) plus share of genes in loci and number of loci; Spacedust source207 rows (DEVELOPMENT) for S-add and S-add+B on both bases at the DPANN-selected theta, paired against the frozen base

expectations.mechanism: confirmed: >= 60% of worse instances span a strand change
expectations.Z_S-add: strict +45 to +60, loose +50 to +70, standing +40 to +60, all seven bars, 0 new pairs, summed -.008 to +.002, every F1 within .005 of the base; JUSTIFIED with probability about one half (the +50 strict bar is the uncertain condition)
expectations.Z_S-add+B: strict +60 to +80, same curated scores as S-add; JUSTIFIED with probability about 0.6
expectations.P_S-add: strict +40 to +55, CRISPR-Cas F1 back within .01 of the base, summed within .01; bars met
expectations.P_S-add+B: bridged unions remain and keep costing runs: strict below P S-add
expectations.added_nodes: adds 5-15% more loci; crossing nodes: few, since strand-first pieces nest inside unmodified runs (crossings arise where an unmodified node ends inside a single-strand piece)
expectations.Spacedust: S-add between the base and S (+.000 to +.015)
